ns2:course.label: Info Sys Analysis and Design
ns2:course.description: Methodologies and techniques used and deliverables created in developing large-scale information systems, including preliminary planning, feasibility analysis, design implementation, and post-implementation review of the system; a term-long project which familiarizes students with methodology and techniques is required. Prerequisite: BADM 350.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to students with Junior or Senior class standing.
